items.title: Albert Glenny Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: But, he was a gay corporate, they called him Jimmy Wright. He'd come down and play, and champagne, all that.

ctx.x: Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.

Yes. Yes. Now, when you were first starting out, they played those Lancers? Did they play High Society? Oh, they played High Society. That's an old number. They played High Society? Oh, yeah, they played it. How old do you think that number is? That number? That number is about four years. About four years. They did no joke. About 40 years old? Yeah, this was about, maybe, I said 45 years. Do you remember any of the numbers that are saying 70 years ago? 70, oh, man, no, no. 60 years ago. When you first started,…
